text: {"lessons":["One sale of Stock B after a large gain does not show that selling winners is a reliable strategy; I should base trades on my portfolio plan, not the gain versus my cost.","My account value rose and fell across periods despite no trades, confirming that short-term price changes are unpredictable and trading cannot eliminate that uncertainty.","I should review the portfolio deliberately but avoid unnecessary trading; any action should reflect my goals, risk tolerance, and available cash."]}
